title: Why context engineering is AI’s next hiring challenge
excerpt: Context engineering is becoming AI hiring's real skills gap
content_html:
Prompt engineering was briefly the face of the AI jobs boom.

In 2025, technology recruitment firm SPG Resourcing reported that UK job listings for AI prompt engineers had grown by 180% over the previous year.

It was an eye-catching figure that captured the mood of the first commercial wave of generative AI. Businesses were trying to understand how to talk to LLMs and turn early experiments into something useful.

That requirement has not disappeared.

CEO & Co-Founder of SurrealDB.

With job site postings for specialist AI roles in the UK rising by 61% from last year according to PWC, it’s clear that good prompts still matter. But most of that new demand is for people who can apply AI inside a business, not just talk to a model.

Many organizations have moved past the first demo. They are now trying to build AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and AI-enabled workflows that operate inside the business.

That creates a different skills gap.

This is the shift behind what I refer to as ‘context engineering’. Although that term is not universally used, the capability is becoming essential.

Companies that want useful AI agents and retrieval-augmented generation systems need people who can design the environment around the model, not just the prompt sent to it.

From better prompts to better context

Prompt engineering is about the instruction, while context engineering is about the world around that instruction.

A support agent does not only need a well-written prompt, it needs the right customer record, policy, product history, and permission boundary. Similarly, a developer agent needs the relevant code, tests, dependencies, and deployment constraints.

In both cases, output quality depends on context. Without it, the model is guessing from incomplete evidence. With too much of it, the system becomes noisy and difficult to govern. The job is to make context useful, current, and controlled.

That’s what makes context engineering distinct from prompt engineering.

Agents raise the stakes

The rise of AI agents makes this more urgent. A chatbot with poor context may give a weak answer, but that same poor context may result in another agent making a serious error.

Once an AI system can call tools, query business systems, maintain state, and act across several steps, context becomes an essential part of the production architecture. It decides what the agent can see, what it can do, and how much confidence the business can place in the outcome.

I’m reminded of a joke about boundary testing. A developer walks into a bar and orders a beer, then he orders five beers, then he orders 999,999,999,999 beers, then he orders -1 beer. The bartender blinks, but everything is okay. A user walks into the bar, asks where the bathroom is and the whole bar explodes.

The same principle applies to AI projects. The first prototype may work against a narrow set of examples, then become fragile when it meets real data. Customer information sits in one system, operational data in another, and important knowledge in documents and files. The agent is expected to reason across all of it, but the context layer has not been designed for that job.

A financial services team, for example, may need to connect CRM data, an existing data platform, and internal documents before an agent can answer accurately. The hard work is not only moving the data. It is shaping it so the agent can retrieve the right evidence and stay inside the right permission boundary.

The job title is still catching up

This creates an awkward hiring moment. The need for context engineering is becoming clearer, but the job title is still unsettled.

Some organizations may seek to specifically hire ‘context engineers’, but many will not. The capability is more likely to appear inside roles such as AI engineer, agent engineer, AI platform engineer, applied AI engineer, or data engineer. In other businesses, it will be a team responsibility shared across data, platform, security, and software engineering.

Leaders therefore need to hire for the work, not the label. A candidate does not need to have ‘context engineer’ on their CV to be useful. The better signal is whether they understand how data moves through systems, how permissions are enforced, and how a prototype becomes something reliable enough for production.

This also means the talent pool is wider than many companies assume. Machine learning expertise is valuable, but context engineering draws heavily on existing engineering disciplines. Data engineers understand pipelines and retrieval.

Platform engineers understand operational resilience. Security teams understand access control and auditability. Software engineers understand how to turn messy requirements into maintainable systems.

The best candidates may look like full-stack AI engineers. They do not need to be specialists in every model, database, or framework, but do need enough range to connect the model layer with the business systems around it.

The Kubernetes lesson and what leaders should do now

The shift has a parallel with the move to cloud-native architecture and Kubernetes. Many companies treated Kubernetes as something to install, then discovered that the harder work was changing how teams built and ran software.

AI creates a similar risk. Companies can buy tools and hire a handful of specialists, but still fail to change the engineering habits around them. Context engineering requires teams to think differently about everything from documentation, and data ownership, to access, testing, and accountability.

It also changes the culture of software development. Engineers are already using AI to write, review, and iterate code. That can improve productivity, but it does not remove responsibility. In areas where performance, reliability, or security matter, human judgement becomes even more important.

CTOs and CIOs should not wait for context engineering to become a mature hiring category. They should start identifying the capability now.

The first step is to examine where AI projects are failing. Is the model genuinely weak, or is the system retrieving poor context? Are permissions clear? Can the team explain why the agent produced a particular answer?

The second step is to build cross-functional teams. AI cannot sit apart from data, platform, security, and product. In many cases, the best approach will be to upskill existing engineers who already understand the organization's systems.

The final step is cultural. Engineers need to become fluent in AI-assisted development while staying accountable for the systems they ship. Leaders need to make room for experimentation, but they also need clear standards for review, evaluation, and governance.

The model is not enough

AI hiring is changing because AI itself is moving into production. Models will continue to improve, and businesses will have many ways to access them. The harder advantage will come from knowing how to connect those models to the right business context.

Companies that understand this will build agents and RAG systems that are more useful, safer, and easier to govern. Companies that ignore it will keep blaming the model when the real weakness is the environment it has to work in.

blocks.html_en: The Kubernetes lesson and what leaders should do now

sentences.en: The Kubernetes lesson and what leaders should do now
sentences.zh: Kubernetes 课程以及领导者现在应该做什么

blocks.html_en: The shift has a parallel with the move to cloud-native architecture and Kubernetes. Many companies treated Kubernetes as something to install, then discovered that the harder work was changing how teams built and ran software.

sentences.en: The shift has a parallel with the move to cloud-native architecture and Kubernetes.
sentences.zh: 这种转变与向云原生架构和 Kubernetes 的转变是相似的。

sentences.en: Many companies treated Kubernetes as something to install, then discovered that the harder work was changing how teams built and ran software.
sentences.zh: 许多公司将 Kubernetes 视为需要安装的东西，然后发现更困难的工作是改变团队构建和运行软件的方式。

blocks.html_en: AI creates a similar risk. Companies can buy tools and hire a handful of specialists, but still fail to change the engineering habits around them. Context engineering requires teams to think differently about everything from documentation, and data ownership, to access, testing, and accountability.

sentences.en: AI creates a similar risk.
sentences.zh: 人工智能也会带来类似的风险。

sentences.en: Companies can buy tools and hire a handful of specialists, but still fail to change the engineering habits around them.
sentences.zh: 公司可以购买工具并聘请少数专家，但仍然无法改变周围的工程习惯。

sentences.en: Context engineering requires teams to think differently about everything from documentation, and data ownership, to access, testing, and accountability.
sentences.zh: 上下文工程要求团队以不同的方式思考一切，从文档、数据所有权到访问、测试和责任。

blocks.html_en: It also changes the culture of software development. Engineers are already using AI to write, review, and iterate code. That can improve productivity, but it does not remove responsibility. In areas where performance, reliability, or security matter, human judgement becomes even more important.

sentences.en: It also changes the culture of software development.
sentences.zh: 它还改变了软件开发的文化。

sentences.en: Engineers are already using AI to write, review, and iterate code.
sentences.zh: 工程师已经在使用人工智能来编写、审查和迭代代码。

sentences.en: That can improve productivity, but it does not remove responsibility.
sentences.zh: 这可以提高生产力，但并不能消除责任。

sentences.en: In areas where performance, reliability, or security matter, human judgement becomes even more important.
sentences.zh: 在性能、可靠性或安全性很重要的领域，人类的判断变得更加重要。

blocks.html_en: CTOs and CIOs should not wait for context engineering to become a mature hiring category. They should start identifying the capability now.

sentences.en: CTOs and CIOs should not wait for context engineering to become a mature hiring category.
sentences.zh: 首席技术官和首席信息官不应等待背景工程成为一个成熟的招聘类别。

sentences.en: They should start identifying the capability now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在应该开始识别这种能力。

blocks.html_en: The first step is to examine where AI projects are failing. Is the model genuinely weak, or is the system retrieving poor context? Are permissions clear? Can the team explain why the agent produced a particular answer?

sentences.en: The first step is to examine where AI projects are failing.
sentences.zh: 第一步是检查人工智能项目失败的地方。

sentences.en: Is the model genuinely weak, or is the system retrieving poor context?
sentences.zh: 该模型是否真的很弱，或者系统检索的上下文是否较差？

sentences.en: Are permissions clear?
sentences.zh: 权限是否明确？

sentences.en: Can the team explain why the agent produced a particular answer?
sentences.zh: 团队能否解释为什么代理会给出特定答案？

blocks.html_en: The second step is to build cross-functional teams. AI cannot sit apart from data, platform, security, and product. In many cases, the best approach will be to upskill existing engineers who already understand the organization's systems.

sentences.en: The second step is to build cross-functional teams.
sentences.zh: 第二步是建立跨职能团队。

sentences.en: AI cannot sit apart from data, platform, security, and product.
sentences.zh: 人工智能离不开数据、平台、安全和产品。

sentences.en: In many cases, the best approach will be to upskill existing engineers who already understand the organization's systems.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，最好的方法是提高已经了解组织系统的现有工程师的技能。

blocks.html_en: The final step is cultural. Engineers need to become fluent in AI-assisted development while staying accountable for the systems they ship. Leaders need to make room for experimentation, but they also need clear standards for review, evaluation, and governance.

sentences.en: The final step is cultural.
sentences.zh: 最后一步是文化。

sentences.en: Engineers need to become fluent in AI-assisted development while staying accountable for the systems they ship.
sentences.zh: 工程师需要熟练掌握人工智能辅助开发，同时对他们交付的系统负责。

sentences.en: Leaders need to make room for experimentation, but they also need clear standards for review, evaluation, and governance.
sentences.zh: 领导者需要为实验留出空间，但他们也需要明确的审查、评估和治理标准。

sentences.zh: 更难的优势将来自于了解如何将这些模型连接到正确的业务环境。

blocks.html_en: CEO & Co-Founder of SurrealDB.

sentences.en: CEO & Co-Founder of SurrealDB.
sentences.zh: SurrealDB 首席执行官兼联合创始人。

content_html_zh:
快速工程曾一度是人工智能就业热潮的代表。

2025 年，技术招聘公司 SPG Reserving 报告称，英国人工智能提示工程师的职位列表比上一年增长了 180%。

这是一个引人注目的人物，捕捉到了生成人工智能第一波商业浪潮的情绪。 企业试图了解如何与法学硕士交谈并将早期实验转化为有用的东西。

这一要求并没有消失。

SurrealDB 首席执行官兼联合创始人。

普华永道 (PWC) 的数据显示，英国专业人工智能职位的招聘网站数量比去年增加了 61%，很明显，良好的提示仍然很重要。 但大部分新需求是针对能够在企业内部应用人工智能的人，而不仅仅是与模型交谈。

许多组织已经过了第一个演示阶段。 他们现在正在尝试构建人工智能代理、检索增强生成（RAG）系统以及在企业内部运行的人工智能工作流程。

这造成了不同的技能差距。

订阅 TechRadar Pro 时事通讯，获取您的企业成功所需的所有热门新闻、观点、功能和指导！

这就是我所说的“情境工程”背后的转变。 尽管该术语并未得到普遍使用，但该功能正变得至关重要。

想要有用的人工智能代理和检索增强生成系统的公司需要能够围绕模型设计环境的人，而不仅仅是发送给模型的提示。

从更好的提示到更好的上下文

即时工程是关于指令的，而情境工程是关于指令周围的世界的。

支持代理不仅需要精心编写的提示，还需要正确的客户记录、策略、产品历史记录和权限边界。 同样，开发代理需要相关的代码、测试、依赖项和部署约束。

在这两种情况下，输出质量都取决于上下文。 如果没有它，模型就会根据不完整的证据进行猜测。 如果太多，系统就会变得嘈杂且难以管理。 我们的工作是使上下文变得有用、最新且可控。

这就是情境工程与即时工程的不同之处。

代理商加大赌注

人工智能代理的兴起使这一问题变得更加紧迫。 上下文较差的聊天机器人可能会给出较弱的答案，但同样较差的上下文可能会导致另一个代理犯下严重错误。

一旦人工智能系统可以调用工具、查询业务系统、维护状态并跨多个步骤执行操作，上下文就成为生产架构的重要组成部分。 它决定了代理可以看到什么、可以做什么以及企业对结果的信心有多大。

我想起一个关于边界测试的笑话。 一位开发人员走进一家酒吧，点了一瓶啤酒，然后他点了五瓶啤酒，然后他点了 999,999,999,999 瓶啤酒，然后他点了 -1 瓶啤酒。 调酒师眨了眨眼睛，但一切都还好。 一名用户走进酒吧，询问卫生间在哪里，整个酒吧爆炸了。

同样的原则也适用于人工智能项目。 第一个原型可能适用于一小部分示例，然后在遇到实际数据时变得脆弱。 客户信息位于一个系统中，运营数据位于另一个系统中，重要知识位于文档和文件中。 代理应该对所有这些进行推理，但上下文层并不是为这项工作而设计的。

例如，金融服务团队可能需要连接 CRM 数据、现有数据平台和内部文档，然后代理才能准确回答。 艰苦的工作不仅仅是移动数据。 它正在塑造它，以便代理可以检索正确的证据并保持在正确的权限范围内。

职称还在追赶

这造成了一个尴尬的招聘时刻。 背景工程的需求变得越来越清晰，但职位名称仍然悬而未决。

一些组织可能会寻求专门聘请“环境工程师”，但许多组织不会。 这种能力更有可能出现在人工智能工程师、代理工程师、人工智能平台工程师、应用人工智能工程师或数据工程师等角色内部。 在其他企业中，这将是跨数据、平台、安全和软件工程共同承担的团队责任。

因此，领导者需要为工作而不是为品牌而招聘。 候选人的简历中并不需要有“背景工程师”才能发挥作用。 更好的信号是他们是否了解数据如何在系统中移动、如何强制执行权限以及原型如何变得足够可靠以用于生产。

这也意味着人才库比许多公司想象的要广泛。 机器学习专业知识很有价值，但上下文工程很大程度上依赖于现有的工程学科。 数据工程师了解管道和检索。

平台工程师了解运营弹性。 安全团队了解访问控制和可审核性。 软件工程师了解如何将混乱的需求转变为可维护的系统。

最好的候选人可能看起来像全栈人工智能工程师。 他们不需要是每个模型、数据库或框架的专家，但确实需要足够的范围来将模型层与其周围的业务系统连接起来。

Kubernetes 课程以及领导者现在应该做什么

这种转变与向云原生架构和 Kubernetes 的转变是相似的。 许多公司将 Kubernetes 视为需要安装的东西，然后发现更困难的工作是改变团队构建和运行软件的方式。

人工智能也会带来类似的风险。 公司可以购买工具并聘请少数专家，但仍然无法改变周围的工程习惯。 上下文工程要求团队以不同的方式思考一切，从文档、数据所有权到访问、测试和责任。

它还改变了软件开发的文化。 工程师已经在使用人工智能来编写、审查和迭代代码。 这可以提高生产力，但并不能消除责任。 在性能、可靠性或安全性很重要的领域，人类的判断变得更加重要。

首席技术官和首席信息官不应等待背景工程成为一个成熟的招聘类别。 他们现在应该开始识别这种能力。

第一步是检查人工智能项目失败的地方。 该模型是否真的很弱，或者系统检索的上下文是否较差？ 权限是否明确？ 团队能否解释为什么代理会给出特定答案？

第二步是建立跨职能团队。 人工智能离不开数据、平台、安全和产品。 在许多情况下，最好的方法是提高已经了解组织系统的现有工程师的技能。

最后一步是文化。 工程师需要熟练掌握人工智能辅助开发，同时对他们交付的系统负责。 领导者需要为实验留出空间，但他们也需要明确的审查、评估和治理标准。

模型不够

人工智能招聘正在发生变化，因为人工智能本身正在进入生产阶段。 模型将不断改进，企业将有多种方式访问​​它们。 更难的优势将来自于了解如何将这些模型连接到正确的业务环境。

了解这一点的公司将构建更有用、更安全、更易于管理的代理和 RAG 系统。 忽视这一点的公司会继续指责该模式，而真正的弱点是它必须所处的环境。
